data.one_liner: A cross-platform whiteboard widget for freehand drawing with controller support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a cross-platform widget for freehand drawing with a controller. Features include saving the whiteboard as an image, undo, redo, an eraser mode, adjustable pencil width and color, and changing the background color.
use_when: You need a drawing canvas or whiteboard in your cross-platform Flutter application.
You require features like undo, redo, and eraser mode for freehand sketches.
avoid_when: You need complex vector graphics manipulation or advanced shape recognition tools.
strengths: Cross-platform support across android, ios, web, windows, macos, and linux
Includes built-in support for undo, redo, eraser, and saving as an image
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced configurations beyond basic features
